title: Acceptance Terms for a Homesite Reservation, by Premium Class
content:
The intake terms below govern which reservations a sales center or the online buyer portal may accept for each premium class of the Homesite Reservation. Each figure belongs to the class of the homesite being reserved.

| Premium class | Maximum age of pre-qualification letter on the reservation date (calendar days) | Occupancy intent investor accepted | Occupancy intent second home accepted | Online reservation allowed | Same buyer may reserve the same homesite again after a release or expiry | Wait before reserving the same homesite again (calendar days) | Maximum active reservations per buyer in one community |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 90 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 14 | 1 |
| Corner Homesite | 90 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 14 | 1 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 60 | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | 30 | 1 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 45 | No | Yes | No | Yes | 30 | 1 |
| Water-View Homesite | 45 | No | Yes | No | No | 45 | 1 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 30 | No | No | No | No | 60 | 1 |

## Reading the terms

- **Pre-qualification letter.** Every reservation requires a lender pre-qualification letter; the figure is the maximum age, in calendar days, of that letter on the reservation date.
- **Occupancy intent.** The two columns state whether a reservation stating investor or second home occupancy is accepted for the class.
- **Online reservation.** "Yes" means the reservation may be placed through the online buyer portal rather than at the sales center; "No" means the portal is not available for that class.
- **Reserving the same homesite again.** The "may reserve again" column states whether the same buyer may reserve the same homesite again after a release or expiry; the wait column gives the calendar days after the release or expiry before that is possible.
- **Holds per community.** The last column is the maximum number of active reservations one buyer may hold in a single community.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A buyer stating second home intent on a Golf-Frontage Homesite finds "No" in that column, while the same intent on a Water-View Homesite finds "Yes".
